name: w h o k i l l

podcast.body: Released in 2011, this album by Tune-Yards (Merrill Garbus) features the song "Gangsta." The music on this album, like other Tune-Yards releases, showcases an eclectic blend of genres, including alternative indie pop, rock, funk, pop, folk, Afrobeat, and free jazz, along with extensive use of loops and samples. "That's Tuneyards, which is actually Merrill Garbis, and that's Gangsta from a 2011 album and tell who killed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
